ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - KrbRelayUp Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects KrbRelayUp used to perform a universal no-fix local privilege escalation in Windows domain environments where LDAP signing is not enforced

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\KrbRelayUp\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "KrbRelayUp\.exe") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ relay\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-Domain\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-ComputerName\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ krbscm\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-sc\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ spawn\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-d\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-cn\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-cp\\ .*")))
